name: Microgrid automatic-mode enable
summary: Permits the defined automatic coordination when its required authority and health inputs are satisfied.
description: Permits the defined automatic coordination when its required authority and health inputs are satisfied. A microgrid operating-mode function coordinates how local sources and loads relate to the utility connection. The selected mode, the measured electrical condition and the actual switching configuration can differ during a transition.

In a microgrid serving a switchroom and industrial loads, the controller can move between grid-connected and islanded operating states only through its defined transition logic. Each state needs identifiable source roles and feedback. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Automatic authority and health” at the input and “Automatic control permission” at the output. Unavailable resources still require separate handling.
